turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My work is offering a cycle to work scheme and I've got three bikes on my shortlist.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a gravel bike that can handle roads and dirt tracks, with space for mudguards.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then a lightweight carbon road bike, really quick, but it eats most of the budget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a sturdy electric hybrid with a big battery and built in lights.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For commuting plus weekend fun, the gravel bike is the most versatile, and mudguards make rainy days easy. The carbon road bike is fast, but less practical day to day. The e-hybrid is great if your commute is long or hilly.
